description: The bar chart illustrates the bias percentage across different contact conditions—No Contact Before, Positive Contact Before, Negative Contact Before, No Contact After, Positive Contact After, and Negative Contact After—under two experimental conditions: Extended Contact and Virtual Contact. The vertical axis represents the bias percentage, ranging from 0 to 70, while the horizontal axis categorizes the contact types. In the Extended Contact condition, the bias percentages are 39.50 for No Contact Before, 31.83 for Positive Contact Before, and 42.38 for Negative Contact Before, with all "After" conditions showing 0.00 bias. In the Virtual Contact condition, the bias percentages are 39.74 for No Contact After, 39.17 for Positive Contact After, and 43.83 for Negative Contact After, with the "Before" conditions showing 10.00 for No Contact Before, 10.01 for Positive Contact Before, and 10.02 for Negative Contact Before. The chart uses different colors and patterns to distinguish between the contact types, with the "After" conditions generally showing lower bias percentages compared to the "Before" conditions, particularly in the Virtual Contact scenario.
